description: Frozen protocol for I3.11f Repeated-Measures R1 vs M3. Everything frozen: T2, R1, M3, A1, prompts, utility, model/config.
research_question: Is the I3.11d R1-M3 success difference stable under repeated sampling, or is it backend/provider response variance?

method.design: Repeated measures: each task run K=5 times per arm (A1, M3, R1)
method.call_ordering: Interleaved/counterbalanced per task (shuffled by task_id-seeded RNG) to reduce confounding from provider drift or changing backend instances
method.estimand: Per-task mean utility and success probability, then bootstrap over tasks (not individual calls) to avoid pseudo-replication
method.n_tasks: 100 (all break-category tasks + random sample of others from I3.11d corpus)

frozen_components.model_config: unchanged (deepseek-v4-flash, temperature=0, max_tokens=2048, thinking disabled, json_object)

analysis.delta: Delta_i = U_bar_{R1,i} - U_bar_{M3,i}; bootstrap tasks, not individual calls
analysis.success_comparison: Mean per-task success probability comparison between R1 and M3

instability_metrics.deterministic_request_rate: fraction of unique request hashes producing one action only
instability_metrics.stop_defer_flip_rate: fraction of unique requests producing both STOP and DEFER
instability_metrics.fingerprint_distribution: distribution of system_fingerprint values across calls

fingerprint_micro_experiment.description: Take exact request from tasks 0009 and 0043 at divergence step. Make 25 interleaved calls each. Record system_fingerprint.
fingerprint_micro_experiment.goal: If action distribution changes with fingerprint, backend routing is causal. If fingerprint is constant and output still changes, that is direct stochastic/numerical variability under identical reported backend conditions.

secondary_criteria.C3: R1 success probability non-inferior to M3 (mean_p_r1 >= mean_p_m3 - 0.01)
secondary_criteria.C4: R1 mean steps < M3 mean steps

decision_rule.if_C2_passes: I3.11d C2 failure was a noisy single-run estimate. R1 dominates M3 in expected utility.
decision_rule.if_C2_fails_but_C3_passes: R1 has a genuine efficiency-reliability tradeoff: cheaper but not reliably better than M3.
decision_rule.if_C2_fails_and_C3_fails: R1 has a genuine efficiency-reliability tradeoff: M3 is more reliable.
